source: NHC National Storm Surge Hazard Map v4 (reprocessed 06/2026), Maximum of MOMs, high tide, Categories 1-5

encoding.red: 40 * first category that floods the pixel; 0 = dry through Category 5
encoding.green: depth class at Category 5: 1 = under 1 ft, n = n-1 to n ft, 21 = more than 20 ft; 0 = dry

resolution: native ~10 m, shown on the slr.png grid (~30 m), nearest neighbour
land_mask: Census tracts minus TIGER/Line 2024 area water
